_help: AI SETTINGS. Used only by the server function, never sent to browsers. Edit values, keep the quotes and commas. Daily limits are per user per day (UTC).
extraGuidance: Prefer coffees suited to pour-over. Keep 'why' sentences short and friendly.
_limits_help: identify = single bag scans; identify_bulk = photos added in one go when setting up a profile; find = 'search the web' for a coffee that isn't in the catalogue (each uses up to findSearches web searches, about $0.01 each). Recommendations and 'similar coffees' no longer use AI: they come from the catalogue.
_thinking_help: thinking: false switches off the model's step-by-step thinking for these simple reading jobs. It is faster and cheaper. Set true if scans start getting things wrong.
